ranking_copy: Ranking is within this snapshot, not user-base incidence. Public-feedback volume is not prevalence among Google Photos users.

taxonomy.name: Design Issues
taxonomy.definition: Difficulty understanding or navigating search UI, or preference for older search functionality.

taxonomy.name: Search UI hard to navigate
taxonomy.definition: Difficulty understanding and navigating the UI to find photos or a photo-finding view (Map, Places, People, Albums, shared albums).

taxonomy.name: Prefer previous search UI
taxonomy.definition: UI changes, with users preferring the older or previous search functionality.

taxonomy.name: Search button or feature removed/moved
taxonomy.definition: An app update removed, relocated, or hid the search entry point itself (search button, search bar or tab) or a specific search function (More like this, search by image, a search filter, keyword search replaced by Ask), so the user cannot reach search. Merely typing into the search bar, poor results, or a face group not showing up in search do not count.

taxonomy.name: Date grouping removed
taxonomy.definition: Photos no longer grouped by date, making them harder to organise and view.

taxonomy.name: System Issues
taxonomy.definition: Search fails because of recognition, metadata, bugs, or other retrieval system errors.

taxonomy.name: Face not detected or grouped
taxonomy.definition: Challenges searching images because a face was not detected or grouped correctly.

taxonomy.name: Incorrect or missing metadata
taxonomy.definition: Challenges searching because place, date, time, file name, or device metadata is wrong or missing.

taxonomy.name: Object or text recognition
taxonomy.definition: Challenges searching images due to object recognition or on-image text search.

taxonomy.name: Other search system failures
taxonomy.definition: Search fails to return the desired photo for reasons other than face, metadata, or objects.

taxonomy.name: Search bugs and glitches
taxonomy.definition: Bugs or glitches that hamper search or finding photos.

taxonomy.name: Query Inference
taxonomy.definition: Search fails to understand the user query or follow-up query.

taxonomy.name: Query not understood
taxonomy.definition: Search feature failing to understand the user's query.

taxonomy.name: Follow-up query ignored
taxonomy.definition: A follow-up search ignores the initial results and jumps to an unrelated photo.

taxonomy.name: Knowledge and Awareness Gaps
taxonomy.definition: User did not know a search capability existed, or the capability is hidden or undocumented.

taxonomy.name: Did not know search capability existed
taxonomy.definition: User did not know a search capability or feature existed, or asks how to use a hidden search feature.
